futures.name: Collin Krum
futures.case: 11-3 and a title-game trip in 2025. The best roster he has ever had — one piece away.

futures.name: Thomas Speer
futures.case: Reigning champion chasing his fourth ring. The Swifties keep finding WR1s in the late rounds.

futures.name: Jared Hall
futures.case: Three rings and the league's deepest résumé. A 7-7 reset year, and nobody wants to see him in the bracket.

futures.name: George Travis
futures.case: The commissioner is always in it. Eight playoff trips in nine seasons and a title in 2022.

futures.name: Bryan Hunt
futures.case: Perennial contender still chasing his first ring — the 11-3 Kenya(n) Pass The Jay season lives in infamy.

futures.name: JD Daley
futures.case: Boom or bust personified — a title in 2019 and more roster chaos since than anyone else in the league.

futures.name: Trevor Hash
futures.case: 10-4 in 2024, then the wheels came off. Team Hash always drafts the same roster, and sometimes that works.

futures.name: Brian Heino
futures.case: Nine wins and a third-place run in 2025. Still chasing ring number one.

futures.name: Vincent Cannarozzi
futures.case: Nine seasons, zero titles, eternal hope. The Nabers era was supposed to be the jump.

futures.name: James Brochu
futures.case: Jigalos Jims strung together winning seasons in 2023 and 2024 before 2025 took a step back.

futures.name: Kyle Fowler
futures.case: A 2018 title and a 3-11 hangover. The roster is young, the hope is thin.

futures.name: German Haro
futures.case: Back-to-back two-win seasons. The only way out is through — and the draft is in August.
